title: Phone Switcher
description: the space switcher as a rail-head menu (SWITCHER_DROPDOWN from @fraym/ui) instead of a column. On a phone the switcher's 56px track is a sixth of the screen, so the `phone` layout puts the switcher inside the session-rail drawer's head and keeps the whole width for the transcript. Same shipped component, different placement — the placement is the implementation's own declaration, which is exactly why a layout can choose it.
